# Anaks Labs

> Anaks Labs Inc. is a software company. We build and operate an AI-powered website platform: sites are compiled, tested and monitored like software, and every page is engineered so that search engines and AI assistants can read, verify and quote it. Search engine optimization is the baseline; answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) are the product. We work by invitation and take a limited number of clients in each area: search results and AI answers are ranked lists, so optimizing competing businesses in the same neighborhood would mean competing against our own clients. One build charge, one flat monthly rate, and the finished site is sent before anything is signed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://anakslabs.com/): What the platform builds and what we run every month — a performance report, eight blog posts, inquiry and booking tracking, and hosting, maintenance and self-serve editing.
- [About](https://anakslabs.com/about/): Who Anaks Labs Inc. is — a software company, its two disciplines (engineering and marketing), corporate information, and answers to common questions.
- [Clinics](https://anakslabs.com/clinics/): The vertical we build for — dental practices and clinics — and what we found when we opened their websites and read what a search engine actually receives.
- [Specimen rebuild](https://anakslabs.com/clinics/example/): One clinic homepage built twice, before and after, with the structural difference between the two measured on the page.
- [Sources](https://anakslabs.com/sources/): Every figure that appears anywhere on this site, with its original source, its sample size, and the date we last checked the link.

## Guides

Ten guides written for one reader: the owner of a dental practice or clinic. Each one describes a symptom, says how to check for it without any tooling, and stops at the diagnosis — none of them contains repair instructions, because the repair is the service we sell. Every figure quoted in a guide is listed on the sources page above, and figures taken from our specimen say in the same paragraph that the specimen is a clinic we invented and two pages we wrote.

- [Guides index](https://anakslabs.com/guides/): All ten, grouped into what changed, what machines receive, and the decisions a practice owner is being asked to make.
- [01 — Your patients now ask AI first](https://anakslabs.com/guides/patients-ask-ai-first/): What two published surveys of US adults counted, what they did not count, and the three changes that reach a practice.
- [02 — Ask an AI assistant about your practice](https://anakslabs.com/guides/ask-an-assistant-about-your-practice/): A ten-minute diagnostic, six kinds of answer, and the symptom each one points at.
- [03 — Why the AI quotes your competitor, and not you](https://anakslabs.com/guides/why-the-ai-quotes-your-competitor/): Six things being left out of an answer is not, including a penalty and anything a competitor could buy.
- [04 — Why a beautiful clinic website can be invisible to machines](https://anakslabs.com/guides/beautiful-but-invisible/): Design quality and machine readability are separate properties; the sixty sites already published as good examples were not spared.
- [05 — The gap between what patients see and what machines receive](https://anakslabs.com/guides/what-patients-see-what-machines-receive/): The difference measured on a specimen clinic homepage we built both halves of, including the part of it we argue against ourselves.
- [06 — What a machine can tell about your practice right now](https://anakslabs.com/guides/what-a-machine-can-tell-checklist/): Twelve checks a clinic owner can run from a phone, and what a no indicates in each case.
- [07 — What monthly content actually does](https://anakslabs.com/guides/what-monthly-content-actually-does/): Three things publishing every month genuinely does, four it cannot, and the attribution problem stated plainly.
- [08 — Redesign vs rebuild: what to check before you decide](https://anakslabs.com/guides/redesign-or-rebuild/): Six questions that separate two purchases sold under one word.
- [09 — Counting inquiries, not people](https://anakslabs.com/guides/counting-inquiries-not-people/): What a clinic can measure without holding anything about who its visitors were, and six questions for whoever runs the site.
- [10 — How to evaluate an agency's SEO claims](https://anakslabs.com/guides/evaluating-an-agency-seo-claims/): Nine questions with correct answers, and a worked example of a health statistic the industry quotes at roughly twice its real value.
